question: What is the title and chapter number of this composed work?
premises: The work is composed by Jñānānanda Paramahaṃsa
It is the sixteenth chapter of Kaulāvalīnirṇaya
inference: This is the sixteenth chapter of the glorious Kaulāvalīnirṇaya composed by Jñānānanda Paramahaṃsa.
plain_english: Thus ends the sixteenth chapter of the glorious Kaulāvalīnirṇaya composed by Jñānānanda Paramahaṃsa.
